title: Prove exact two-coordinate Euclidean cap envelope (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact two-dimensional Euclidean resolvent optimum under simultaneous absolute row and fractional column caps. This answers dimension two of zhaobenny's #6816 Open next question 2. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```text
0 < rho < 1, beta >= 1
c = min(beta-1, 1)
t = rho*c/(1-rho+rho*c)
max ||(I-E)^(-1)||_2 = sqrt(1-t+t^2+t*sqrt(t^2-2t+2))/(1-rho)
attainer E = rho * [[1,0],[c,1-c]]
```

Here E ranges over all complex 2-by-2 matrices with absolute row sums at most rho and column sums at most beta*rho. At rho=1/2 and beta=3/2, the value is exactly `(2/3)*sqrt(7+sqrt(13))`. The proof uses nonnegative comparison, row completion, stochastic coordinates and norm convexity. The dimension-growth theorem in #6816 is credited background, not an imported lemma or a replay target. Nick Petalas #6788 and ToikY #6806 concern the distinct induced 1-norm; aliromman #5255/#5306, 1337isnot1337 #4100 and jwr404 #4282 retain the Gaussian/conditioning lineage. Classical methods retain their credit; general literature priority is unclaimed.

Only six new files under `research/two-coordinate-euclidean-resolvent/` are added. The original uniform-transfer-audit card is retained with changed, partial scope. This is an abstract conditioning side result; its actual-caller gate remains unmet.

## Evidence

Before: #6816 explicitly leaves exact finite-dimensional maxima open. After: `PROOF.md` gives the all-parameter dimension-two closed form and an attaining matrix, including complex phases and fractional beta.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only, exact head `1cc5803dbed03bd9cafe23a6bd5ef6f36f771307`:

- Direct and registered warning-strict normal and optimized replay pass with identical generated receipts: 4,952 nonnegative rational cap cases, 2,883 Gaussian-rational phase cases, 594 attaining parameter presentations and sixteen controls. Every matrix case checks both inverse products and the three Hermitian PSD principal minors. Every attaining case checks the eigenvalue identity. Rational cases also check row completion, inverse domination and the stochastic-coordinate formula. Counts refer to the explicitly enumerated finite domains; repeated rational parameters are presentations.
- Registered commands individually took 1.56 and 1.46 seconds locally, below their 120-second limits. These are timeout observations, not a performance comparison.
- Metadata/pins and exact committed-byte/source-history checks pass. Official export integrity/input coverage and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay pass with empty PATH/PYTHONPATH. All seven export members, including the generated manifest, remain unchanged and both exported receipts equal the local receipts.
- In-memory compilation, function-size inspection and whitespace checks pass. The longest function is nineteen physical lines. Generated receipts bind all six package files by SHA256; no receipt is hand-written.
- The selected baseline binding control passed. Canonical main was fetched at intake and before commitment and remained `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The selected record is #7000; the task catalogue still carries historical revision-8 context.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem concerns dimension exactly two, beta>=1, unrestricted support and permitted diagonal entries. The proof covers arbitrary real parameters; the executable formula accepts rational parameters with at most 256-bit numerator/denominator height. Finite checks corroborate the written proof. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

No actual emitted Gaussian block, physical precision bill, native realization, owned restoration, stock, compiler, analytic recovery or complete supplier invoice is supplied. All selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native suite, Lean or Docker run was performed. Every registered command ran locally; no package check is deferred solely to CI.

## Open next questions

- Determine the dimension-three optimum, beginning at rho=1/2 and beta=3/2. Rational transportation vertices offer a finite experiment, but a new extremality proof is needed; this proof does not justify restricting the resolvent maximum to vertices.
- Bind the caps to one actual emitted two-coordinate Gaussian error block and price its preparation, rounding and restoration. Both source binding and the physical bill remain missing.

The remote overlap snapshot covers all 826 open PR bodies and 7,442 Discussion records. Main-tree README searches supplement incomplete sparse local-note coverage; unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain outside the search. The precommit refresh found no competing claim or delivered formula for this dimension-two problem. The completion refresh inspected all 119 open PRs from this account, including the six created since the CLAIM. The other five, #7527, #7530, #7531, #7532 and #7533, concern the four-wire parity suffix infinity norm, permutation tensor layouts, shared-hub query dimension, nested-flow source counts and an A7+A1 COPY reduction. None studies this simultaneous-cap Euclidean resolvent optimum or computes a competing value; no additional comparison computations were run.
